markingWarnings: 01.1 requires distinct apparatus-function statements; incorrect apparatus terminology cannot be rescued by generic quantum keywords.
01.2 permits consequential calculation marks from an earlier wavelength; note independent method and accuracy stages.
01.3 requires observed-pattern reasoning tied to de Broglie relation and an apparatus figure.
01.4 is one discrete selected option, not a description needing multiple rubric points.
02.1 requires a calculated comparison to a high-enough precision, not a memorised speed alone.
02.2 assesses four linked field-change and detection mechanisms, not a bag of keywords.
02.3 accepts mathematically valid stationary-wave path with ECF for wavelength; must relate result to available geometry.
03 is a SIX-MARK LEVELS-OF-RESPONSE item assessed holistically across method, prediction, evidence and significance, not six independent ticks.
04.2 contains four calculation stages—frame-adjusted distance, time, decay fraction and final half-life—so a correct value/alternative method must be considered.
04.3 is an independent proper-time interpretation mark.
